code: import api from'./Api';const getUserAccounts=async()=>{const token=localStorage.getItem('token');const userID=localStorage.getItem('userID');if(!token||!userID){throw new Error('No se encontró la sesión del usuario.');}const response=await api.post('/bank/account',{userID},{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}});return response.data.data;};export default getUserAccounts;
